title: dxdy's Flowable directory card carries no website link, so its identity was resolved outside the directory
content:
The Flowable card for dxdy has no website link on it. The row nonetheless carries a domain, dxdydigital.com, which means the identity had to be established outside the directory rather than read off the listing.

That is a small but concrete limit on what a directory sweep produces. Where the vendor's card omits a field, the mined row either stays blank or is completed from another source, and the two cases look identical afterwards. For a sweep that was explicitly not imprint-swept, knowing which fields came from the card and which were resolved elsewhere is the difference between a verified and an assumed record.

The firm is excluded in any case: its footprint is recorded as US plus Sri Lanka and Singapore, outside the EU scope of this brief.
